objective: Prove one authorized GARI research packet can traverse the estate through independently recorded acknowledgements without collapsing authority or fabricating runtime completion.
acceptance_criteria: correlation ID preserved across every hop
each organ writes an independent append-only acknowledgement
no hop is reported complete before its receipt exists
no destructive action, canon supersession, or scientific-truth promotion occurs
final proof chains all receipt commit SHAs

evidence_requirements.description: Git commit created in each participating organ repository
Same canary and correlation identifiers across receipts
Final ProofGrid-style receipt only after all required acknowledgements exist
